pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: lib/foundry/scout/store.ts:182 The /scout seat opens its own night with `open --ceiling` (pipeline/scout.mts num() accepts any positive number) into a night.json it can write. The per-launch spend guard reads that ceiling, so the governed party sets the guard's input, held only by a skill instruction (.claude/skills/scout/SKILL.md:69 'never raise --ceiling') rather than by custody.

techniques.evidence: lib/foundry/scout/store.ts:182 No operator-issued upper bound. The ceiling the budget guard enforces (budget.ts:175) is whatever the governed seat passed when it opened the night.

lib/foundry/scout/plan.ts:165 The seat only submits queued plan items to the store. The night-fill timer launches them detached, outside any run (planDoors.ts:42), and the worker drives the jobs, so no handle lives in the model's context.

lib/foundry/scout/nightFill.ts:83 An interrupted paid job becomes a hold that the tick never clears. It is treated as an unknown outcome, not as failed (budget.ts:35 also keeps a lapsed hold counting because its outcome is unknown).

pairs.evidence: lib/sound/cli.ts:4 The context is a tool that agents call (CLI, vendor engine adapters, take store) and assembles no agent runtime. Its 14 files contain no runAgent/spawn of a model, no hook chain and no checkpoint store. Searching lib/sound for claudeCli, subagent, compaction and registerHook found nothing. Only lib/sound/cover/brief/write.ts (outside this context's file list) calls runAgent.
